migrations.needle: test('4442魂印低400以下混合共同增长、高伤共同重置但附伤范围不猜，跨400统计分歧只记pending不选连击增长',()=>{for(const mode of ['low','high','split']){const s=make(pick(29)[0],{soul:1658});if(mode==='high')timer(s,0,'攻击最低伤害',{amount:201});if(mode==='split')timer(s,0,'攻击最低伤害',{amount:180});const o=turn(s);assert.equal(sum(o,'fixed'),100);if(mode==='low')assert.equal(o.fighters[0].soulState.martinaHits,4);if(mode==='high'){assert.equal(o.fighters[0].soulState.martinaHits,2);assert.ok(o.fighters[0].soulState.pendingMartinaExtra);assert.equal(sum(o,'percent'),0);}if(mode==='split'){assert.ok(o.fighters[0].soulState.pendingMartinaCounter);assert.equal(o.fighters[0].soulState.pendingMartinaCounter.attack,360);assert.equal(o.fighters[0].soulState.pendingMartinaCounter.all,460);}}});
migrations.insert: test('4442已答魂印仅红伤决定400与追加，固定100不纳阈值也不纳追加',()=>{for(const mode of ['low','high','split']){const s=make(pick(29)[0],{soul:1658});if(mode==='high')timer(s,0,'攻击最低伤害',{amount:201});if(mode==='split')timer(s,0,'攻击最低伤害',{amount:180});const o=turn(s);assert.equal(sum(o,'fixed'),100);assert.equal(o.fighters[0].soulState.martinaHits,mode==='high'?2:4);assert.equal(sum(o,'percent'),mode==='high'?402:0);assert.equal(o.fighters[0].soulState.pendingMartinaExtra,undefined);assert.equal(o.fighters[0].soulState.pendingMartinaCounter,undefined);}});
